title: Acceptance bound yields local testing
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $\beta$ be a codomain, let $T$ be a randomized nonadaptive tester on functions $\Omega\to\beta$, and let $P$ be a property of such functions. Suppose its rate $\rho$ is positive, every function satisfying $P$ is accepted with probability one, and for every $\varepsilon\in[0,1]$ and every function $f$, acceptance probability at least $1-\rho\varepsilon$ implies that $f$ is within relative Hamming distance $\varepsilon$ of some function satisfying $P$. Then $T$ is a local tester for $P$ with rate $\rho$: every function satisfying $P$ is accepted with probability one, and every function more than $\varepsilon$ away from all functions satisfying $P$ is rejected with probability greater than $\rho\varepsilon$ for each $\varepsilon\in[0,1]$.
